themes.thesis: Mining is the market's biggest post-earnings winner this cycle — 167-name cohort up +6.62% median, led by Century Aluminum and Taseko Mines.
themes.rationale: Mining's median 3-day reaction sits at +6.62% across 167 tickers on 2,630 news items over the past two weeks — the strongest of any tracked sector. Century Aluminum (+13.56%) and Taseko Mines (+8.83%) led gainers after Q2 reports. Hudbay Minerals was named to the TSX30 for top exchange performance, and Ivanhoe Electric mapped a $1B debt-financing path for its Arizona copper project.

themes.thesis: Copper's pure-play miners are consolidating — Capstone Copper closed its San Pietro acquisition as the 6-name cohort reacts +2.63% median.
themes.rationale: Copper's narrow 6-ticker cohort posted a +2.63% median 3-day reaction on 248 news items. Taseko Mines led with +8.83% after its Q2 report. Capstone Copper completed its acquisition of the San Pietro copper concessions, consolidating its Mantoverde-Santo Domingo district in Chile. Hudbay Minerals, also up +2.63%, was named to the TSX30 and continues building its copper footprint via a stake in Panoro Minerals.

themes.thesis: Oil & gas sold off broadly post-Q2 — 33-name cohort down -2.48% median even as APA and Occidental surged double digits same day.
themes.rationale: Oil-gas's median 3-day reaction was -2.48% across 33 names and 1,021 news items, the weakest post-earnings readout of the sectors we track this cycle. Reactions were wide open on the same Aug-5 reporting day: APA Corporation jumped +17.97% and Occidental Petroleum +8.61%, while Texas Pacific Land fell -8.62%. Elsewhere in the group, Valeura Energy pushed ahead with its Wassana field redevelopment in Thailand.
